issues.title: [Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` puts a control panel on the skills installed in your OpenCode setup. It can list them, explain why one is unavailable, hide one from the model, and bring it back.

Disabling never touches skill files: it writes a single `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing the rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

Install in one command: `opencode plugin add github:sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (details below).

## What's changed since v0.1.0

**Fixed — `list` reported the wrong state.** It merged every agent's permission rules before evaluating them, so deny rules owned by sub-agents (`explorer`, `title`, …) leaked into the caller's result: on a stock setup 28 of 29 skills showed up as `disabled` while `inspect` said they were available. en.headline: 17 own commits across three repos, plus v0.2.0 of opencode-skill-management,
en.summary: Today's **17 own commits** went to `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (11), `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (3) and `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (3), plus 29 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `opencode-skill-management`, CI now publishes idempotently — re-running or re-pushing a tag no longer fails — alongside a README rewritten for users, a new `tools/linux-verify.sh` one-shot acceptance script with four environment pitfalls documented, and the `v0.2.0` version bump; the remaining commits record real-host verification (WSL2 Debian, 167 items, disable→rejected→enable round-trip) and 0.1.0's trusted publishing with provenance. In `opencode-agent-sandbox`, the docs gained a `chrome-devtools-mcp` category and an `eval-comparison` category, with a MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free single-file demo of a pelican riding a bicycle. In `sogeisetsu`, the daily-report wording gate was tightened so reusing old narration is checked, `verify` now also validates the daily AI body, `check.yml` supports manual re-runs, and automated commits must be phrased as additive rather than inclusive. One issue was opened in `openchamber/openchamber`: #5293, about the project actions menu's auto-discover dev server running the first saved action instead of discovering a server, to which `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied that the cause had been traced and marked it `fix-ready`.

releaseNotes.summary: `skill_management` adds a control panel over the skills installed in an OpenCode setup: `list` reports each skill's effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`), `inspect` explains why one is (un)available, and `disable` hides it from the model with a single `skill` permission rule (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable) written to global config. Disabling never touches skill files — nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing the rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 17 次本人提交，发布 opencode-skill-management v0.2.0，并向上游报了一个 bug
zh.summary: 今天 **17 次本人提交** 分布在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`（11 次）、`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（3 次）和 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（3 次），另有 `github-actions[bot]` 的 29 次自动提交。在 `opencode-skill-management` 中，CI 发布改为幂等——版本已存在则跳过，重推 tag 或重跑不再红叉；同时 README 按使用者视角重写，新增 `tools/linux-verify.sh` 一键验收脚本并固化了 4 个环境坑，另有 `v0.2.0` 版本号提交；其余提交记录真实宿主核验（WSL2 Debian · 167 项 · disable→拒载→enable 全链路）、git spec 运行时加载实测、发布生命周期验收，以及 0.1.0 的 trusted publishing（Valid · provenance）。在 `opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，知识库新增 `chrome-devtools-mcp` 与 `eval-comparison` 两个类别，并做了 MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free 的鹈鹕骑自行车单文件演示。在 `sogeisetsu` 中，日报措辞闸门收紧（沿用旧叙述前先过检查，`verify` 也校验日报 AI 正文），`check.yml` 支持手动补跑，并要求自动提交必须写成相加而非包含式表述。另在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 issue #5293：项目操作菜单中 auto-discover dev server 会运行第一个已保存的动作而非发现服务器，`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称原因已定位并标记为 `fix-ready`。

releaseNotes.summary: `skill_management` 为 OpenCode 中已安装的技能提供控制面板：`list` 给出每个技能对调用者 agent 的生效状态（`available` / `disabled` / `ask`），`inspect` 解释某技能为何（不）可用，`disable` 则向全局配置写入单条 `skill` 权限规则（`effect: "deny"`，软禁用为 `"ask"`）以向模型隐藏它。禁用不触碰技能文件——不删除、不移动、不重写，删除该规则即可逐字节还原。
